d:
MMDR Act Amendment:kendr aur rajy sarkar MMDR ekt ko lekar aamne-samne hai. vidhanasbha ke vishesh satr men CM hemant soren ne saph kar diya, MMDR unhen manjur nahin hai. rajy sarkar kanuni vikalp talash rahi hai. JMM ka aarop hai - kendr sarkar ne gupchup tarike se vidheyak parit karva liya tha. vahin, BJP ka kahna hai - MMDR ekt sirph jharkhand nahin, pure desh men lagu huaa hai, jharkhand men ise bevjah tul diya ja raha hai.
